english.note: Use this specifically when separating items into groups according to their type or other criteria.
This is the all-purpose choice for putting things into categories or classes.

examples.english: We sort the rubbish into categories to make recycling easier.
examples.traditional: 我哋將啲垃圾分類，方便回收。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 laap6 saap3 fan1 leoi6 fong1 bin6 wui4 sau1

examples.english: We classify the documents by purpose.
examples.traditional: 我哋會按用途將啲文件分類。
